C1483.title: Jay Chou's BAYC NFT Theft Incident
C1483.summary: In April 2022, a Bored Ape Yacht Club NFT held by singer Jay Chou was stolen, with a value exceeding 3.2 million yuan. It was reportedly or allegedly stolen through phishing or authorization fraud, with attackers quickly transferring the asset after obtaining wallet authorization. Confirming the exact technical path requires adding chain analysis, wallet authorization records, or contemporaneous media reports.
